caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal latch mechanism mounted on a surface, drawn in shades of brown to suggest a brass or bronze appearance. The main plate of the latch is rectangular with rounded corners and is secured by four visible screws, one at each corner. Attached to this plate is an ornate lever arm featuring a rounded knob at one end and decorative scrollwork near the pivot. The lever is positioned above a curved handle that hangs downward. To the right of the main plate is a vertical rectangular striker plate, fastened with two screws, into which the latch bolt fits when the mechanism is engaged. Above the latch, there is a smaller separate drawing showing a side view of the turn knob in two possible positions, indicated by dashed lines and arrows curving above it, which illustrate the rotational movement needed to operate the latch mechanism. The entire composition is done in a realistic style, using various tones of brown and muted gold with shadows to give depth and metallic texture. The drawing is framed by a thin rectangular border, and at the bottom center, the name "J. STALOFF" is written.
title: Bar Latch
